newsitem.title: UK: UK general election not later than May 1 - Major.
newsitem.headline: UK general election not later than May 1 - Major.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Thursday the country's next general election will be held on or before May 1.
The latest possible date for a general election is May 22.
UK general election not later than May 1 -Major =2
"It's certainly not going to be later (than May 1). You can be absolutely certain about that," Major told BBC radio.
He added: "But I am not going to give you a date this morning."
Major has been widely expected to wait until almost the last possible date for a general election, in the hope that an improving economy will boost the popularity of his Conservative Party.
Most recent opinion polls have put the Conservatives around 20 points behind the opposition Labour Party, although the latest poll said the gap had narrowed to 14 points.
